walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the CCEA GCSE Religious Studies specification.

Christianity through a Study of the Acts of the Apostles appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Christianity through a Study of the Acts of the Apostles in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The CCEA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Christianity through a Study of the Acts of the Apostles.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
